description: You don't see anything similar since Jobs and Wozniak, Ritchie with C, Thompson with Unix, or Mr. Stallman and Linus with GNU/Linux, yes, this team are made to make a change, we believe in the FOSS and in the word of St. IGNUcius. May the truth of Free Software be with you, brothers; amen.
summary: In this project, actual NASA protocols were used to enable communication between a gateway and microcontrollers—such as the ESP32 and Arduino—to display a simplified map of Mars for navigation purposes.
details: The main idea behind this project was to provide a platform for developers based on actual NASA protocols, making information and documentation from various NASA repositories easily accessible.
